[assistant] - [High] .claude/settings.local.json:40 — Allowlisting `codex exec -s danger-full-access ...` permits unrestricted command execution from Claude hooks/settings, which weakens the existing destructive-action guard.
- [Medium] core/hooks/skill_self_evolution.py:164 — Falling back every skill evolution to the shared `_skill_evolution` run writes all events into one unbounded `runs/_skill_evolution/events.jsonl`, creating a long-term growth/performance issue and making events hard to associate with the actual run.
- [Low] core/events/run_event.py:124 — `append()` now logs every write failure at error level; repeated disk/permission failures can flood logs from a fire-and-forget event path.
